unitTitle: Culture Clips 1 - Routes to Central Europe
scanNote:
Culture Clips 1-mavzusining ikkinchi beti. Bosilgan bet raqami: 155.

Betda:
• O'ng yuqorida sarlavha takrori: 'Routes to Central Europe' va sariq '1' raqami
• Katta rangli XARITA: England (London, Folkestone, Dover), English Channel, Channel Tunnel chizig'i, France (Coquelles, Calais, Dunkirk), Belgium (Ostend, Zeebrugge). Parom yo'llari qizil nuqtali chiziqlar bilan ko'rsatilgan, ulardan birida kema tasviri.
• Yuqori chapda katta DENGIZ KOMPASI (rumbalari: N, NNE, NE, ENE, E, ESE, SE, SSE, S, SSW, SW, WSW, W, WNW, NW, NNW)
• O'ng yuqorida IKKINChI MATN — Channel Tunnel haqida
• Chap pastda FAKTLAR QUTISI (qiyshiq qo'yilgan qog'oz)
• O'ng pastda 'Speaking' — ikkita muhokama savoli

⚠ 154-betdagi 2a va 2b mashqlarining bir qismi aynan shu betdagi matn, faktlar qutisi va xaritaga tayanadi.

⚠ FAKT TEKShIRUVI: kitobdagi ma'lumotlar to'g'ri — Channel Tunnel 1994-yilning may oyida ochilgan, uzunligi taxminan 50 km, dengiz tubidan taxminan 40 metr pastda o'tadi, Folkestone-Coquelles poyezd safari 35 daqiqa.

⚠ HALOL IZOH: '57 million people' raqami kitob yozilgan davrga tegishli — yillar o'tishi bilan bu son ortib boradi.

sections.title: Routes to Central Europe (2) - The Channel Tunnel
sections.titleUz: Markaziy Yevropaga yo'llar (2) - Bo'g'oz osti tunneli

exercises.instructionEn: READING TEXT 2: If you don't like boats, why not go on a journey under the sea?
exercises.instructionUz: 2-MATN: Kemani yoqtirmasangiz, dengiz ostidan sayohat qilsangiz-chi?
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — 1-MAVZUNING IKKINChI BETI.

  Bu yerda IKKINChI MATN (tunnel haqida),
  XARITA va FAKTLAR QUTISI bor.

  ⚠ 154-betdagi 2a va 2b mashqlarining
  javoblari qisman shu betda.


IKKINChI MATN:

  'If you don't like boats, why not go on
   a journey under the sea? The Channel
   Tunnel is 50 km long and 40 metres
   below the SEABED. Getting from the
   port at Folkestone across to Coquelles
   near Calais is only a 35-minute train
   journey through the tunnel. It's more
   EXPENSIVE than a ferry, but QUICKER
   and much more EXCITING. Thanks to the
   Channel Tunnel, it is now possible to
   spend the day in Paris shopping and
   SIGHTSEEING, and be back in London in
   time for dinner in the evening!'


TARJIMASI:

  'Kemalarni yoqtirmasangiz, dengiz ostidan
   sayohat qilsangiz-chi? Bo'g'oz osti
   tunneli 50 km uzunlikda va dengiz tubidan
   40 metr pastda joylashgan. Folkeston
   portidan Kale yaqinidagi Kokellga o'tish —
   tunnel orqali atigi 35 daqiqalik poyezd
   safari. Bu paromdan qimmatroq, lekin
   tezroq va ancha qiziqarliroq. Bo'g'oz osti
   tunneli tufayli endi kunni Parijda xarid
   qilib va shahar tomosha qilib o'tkazish
   hamda kechki ovqatga ulgurib Londonga
   qaytish mumkin!'


FAKTLAR QUTISI:

  'Since it opened in 1994, 57 million
   people and 12,000 cats and dogs have
   travelled through the Channel Tunnel.'

  = '1994-yilda ochilganidan beri tunnel
     orqali 57 million odam va 12 000 mushuk
     va it sayohat qilgan.'

  ⚠ Bu quti 154-betdagi 5-gapning javobi:
  tunnel 1994-yilda ochilgan (1995 EMAS).

  ⚠ HALOL IZOH: '57 million' raqami kitob
  yozilgan davrga tegishli — yillar o'tishi
  bilan bu son ortib boradi.


⚠⚠ 'SINCE' + PRESENT PERFECT:

  'SINCE it opened in 1994, 57 million
   people HAVE TRAVELLED ...'

  ⚠ 'since' (... dan beri) — o'tmishda
  boshlanib, HOZIRGACHA davom etayotgan
  davr.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun fe'l PRESENT PERFECT
  ('have/has + 3-shakl'):
     'have TRAVELLED'  ✓
     'travelled'       ✗ (Past Simple)

  ⚠ 'SINCE' va 'FOR' farqi:
     SINCE + BOShLANISh NUQTASI
        since 1994, since Monday
     FOR   + DAVOMIYLIK
        for 30 years, for two hours


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR (2a mashqining
  ikkinchi qismi — 'explain the words in
  bold'):

  seabed
     'sea' + 'bed' = dengiz TUBI
     ⚠ 'bed' bu yerda 'to'shak' emas,
     'tub, yotoq' ma'nosida.

  expensive
     = qimmat
     ⚠ zid ma'nosi: 'cheap' (arzon)

  sightseeing
     'sight' + 'seeing' = diqqatga
     sazovor joylarni tomosha qilish
     ⚠ 'to go sightseeing' = shahar
     tomosha qilgani bormoq

  154-betdagi qalin so'zlar:
     Tunnel  = tunnel
     ports   = portlar
     ferries = paromlar


⚠ XARITADAGI JOYLAR:

  ANGLIYA (England):
     London      — poytaxt
     Folkestone  — tunnel boshlanadigan port
     Dover       — parom porti

  FRANSIYA (France):
     Coquelles   — tunnel chiqadigan joy
     Calais      — Kale porti
     Dunkirk     — Dyunkerk porti

  BELGIYA (Belgium):
     Ostend      — port
     Zeebrugge   — port

  ⚠ TUNNEL: Folkestone ↔ Coquelles
  ⚠ PAROM:  Dover ↔ Calais / Dunkirk /
            Ostend / Zeebrugge

  ⚠ E'TIBOR BERING: tunnel Doverdan EMAS,
  FOLKESTONE dan boshlanadi!


⚠ KOMPAS (xaritadagi):

  16 ta rumb ko'rsatilgan:
     N, NNE, NE, ENE, E, ESE, SE, SSE,
     S, SSW, SW, WSW, W, WNW, NW, NNW

  ⚠ 'NNE' = North-North-East
     (shimol-shimoli-sharq)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the seabed   = dengiz tubi
  expensive    = qimmat
  cheap        = arzon
  sightseeing  = shahar tomoshasi
  a tunnel     = tunnel
  since        = ... dan beri
  possible     = mumkin
  thanks to    = ... tufayli
  in time for  = ... ga ulgurib
  to spend the day = kunni o'tkazmoq

points.en: If you don't like boats, why not go on a journey under the sea?
points.uz: Kemalarni yoqtirmasangiz, dengiz ostidan sayohat qilsangiz-chi?
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to go ON a journey' — 'on' bilan.

⚠ 'a journey' = safar (uzunroq);
'a trip' = sayohat (qisqaroq).

⚠ 'Why not + fe'l' — taklif ('you' yo'q).

points.en: The Channel Tunnel is 50 km long and 40 metres below the seabed.
points.uz: Bo'g'oz osti tunneli 50 km uzunlikda va dengiz tubidan 40 metr pastda.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 154-betdagi 3-gapning javobi shu yerda!

50 km — UZUNLIGI ('long'),
40 metr — ChUQURLIGI ('below the seabed').

⚠ O'lchov + sifat tartibi:
  '50 km LONG'  ✓  (raqam oldin, sifat keyin)
  'long 50 km'  ✗

'the seabed' = 'sea' + 'bed' = dengiz tubi.

points.en: Getting from Folkestone to Coquelles is only a 35-minute train journey.
points.uz: Folkestondan Kokellga o'tish — atigi 35 daqiqalik poyezd safari.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 'a 35-MINUTE journey' — 'minuteS' EMAS!

Ot oldidan sifat bo'lib kelganda o'lchov
BIRLIKDA qoladi va DEFIS qo'yiladi:
  'a 35-minute journey'   ✓
  'a 35-minutes journey'  ✗

⚠ Solishtiring: 'The journey takes 35
MINUTES.' (bu yerda ko'plikda)

⚠ Tunnel FOLKESTONE dan boshlanadi,
Doverdan emas!

points.en: It's more expensive than a ferry, but quicker and much more exciting.
points.uz: Bu paromdan qimmatroq, lekin tezroq va ancha qiziqarliroq.
points.noteUz:
⚠ QIYOSIY DARAJANING IKKI YO'LI shu bitta
gapda:
  UZUN sifat → 'MORE expensive',
                'MORE exciting'
  QISQA sifat → 'quickER'

⚠ 'MUCH more exciting' — 'much' qiyosiy
darajani kuchaytiradi ('very' EMAS!).

⚠ 'expensive' va 'exciting' — 2b mashqidagi
ta'kidlangan so'zlar.

points.en: Thanks to the Channel Tunnel, it is now possible to spend the day in Paris.
points.uz: Bo'g'oz osti tunneli tufayli endi kunni Parijda o'tkazish mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'THANKS TO' = ... tufayli (YAXSHI natija).

⚠ Yomon natija uchun 'BECAUSE OF':
'Because of the rain, we stayed at home.'

⚠ 'it is possible TO + fe'l' — qolip.

'to spend the day' = kunni o'tkazmoq.

points.en: ... and be back in London in time for dinner in the evening!
points.uz: ... va kechki ovqatga ulgurib Londonga qaytish!
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 'IN TIME' va 'ON TIME' FARQI:

  'IN TIME for dinner' = ovqatga ULGURIB
     (kerakli paytdan oldin)

  'ON TIME' = AYNAN VAQTIDA
     'The train arrived on time.'

⚠ 'to be back' = qaytmoq.

points.en: Since it opened in 1994, 57 million people and 12,000 cats and dogs have travelled through the Channel Tunnel.
points.uz: 1994-yilda ochilganidan beri tunnel orqali 57 million odam va 12 000 mushuk va it sayohat qilgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ FAKTLAR QUTISIDAN. Bu — 154-betdagi
5-gapning javobi: 1994, 1995 EMAS.

⚠⚠ 'SINCE' + PRESENT PERFECT:
'have TRAVELLED' — o'tmishda boshlanib
hozirgacha davom etgan.

⚠ 'million' RAQAM bilan kelsa KO'PLIK
OLMAYDI:
  '57 million people'   ✓
  '57 millions people'  ✗

⚠ HALOL IZOH: 57 million — kitob yozilgan
davr raqami; hozir undan ko'p.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the map: match each place to its country and role.
exercises.instructionUz: Xaritaga qarang: har bir joyni mamlakati va vazifasi bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
XARITADA 8 TA JOY BELGILANGAN.

  ⚠ Bu mashq kitobda yo'q — xaritani
  o'qishni mashq qilish uchun qo'shildi.


IKKI XIL YO'L:

  TUNNEL (qora chiziq):
     Folkestone ↔ Coquelles

  PAROM (qizil nuqtali chiziqlar):
     Dover ↔ Calais
     Dover ↔ Dunkirk
     Dover ↔ Ostend
     Dover ↔ Zeebrugge

  ⚠⚠ ENG KO'P ADAShTIRILADIGAN JOY:
  tunnel DOVERDAN EMAS, FOLKESTONE dan
  boshlanadi. Dover — parom porti.


⚠ 'THE ENGLISH CHANNEL' xaritada
Angliya bilan Fransiya orasidagi ko'k
hudud.

pairs.whyUz:
Xaritada chap tomonda, sohildan ichkarida.

⚠ Matnda: 'be back in London in time for
dinner' — tunnel tufayli Parijdan bir kunda
qaytish mumkin.

pairs.right: England - the Channel Tunnel starts here
pairs.whyUz:
⚠⚠ ENG MUHIM JOY!

Matnda: 'Getting from the PORT AT
FOLKESTONE across to Coquelles'.

⚠ Ko'pchilik tunnel Doverdan boshlanadi
deb o'ylaydi — XATO.

154-betdagi matnda: 'Dover, on the south
coast of England, is one of the world's
busiest ports.'

⚠ Doverdan PAROM ketadi, tunnel emas.

pairs.right: France - the Channel Tunnel ends here
pairs.whyUz:
Matnda: 'across to Coquelles NEAR CALAIS'.

⚠ Coquelles — Kale shahri yonidagi kichik
joy. Xaritada Kaledan chaproqda.

pairs.right: France - ferries from Dover arrive here
pairs.rightUz: Fransiya — Doverdan paromlar shu yerga keladi
pairs.whyUz:
Matnda: 'A traditional ferry takes 90
minutes from Dover to Calais.'

⚠ Katamaran esa 35 daqiqada boradi.

154-betdagi matnda: 'to Calais and DUNKIRK
in France'.

⚠ Xaritada Kaledan o'ngroqda, Belgiya
chegarasiga yaqin.

154-betdagi matnda: 'or to OSTEND and
Zeebrugge in BELGIUM'.

⚠ Bu — 154-betdagi 6-gapning javobi:
Ostend Belgiyada (Right).

pairs.right: Belgium - the farthest ferry port on the map
pairs.rightUz: Belgiya — xaritadagi eng uzoq parom porti
pairs.whyUz:
Xaritada eng o'ng yuqorida — Doverdan eng
uzoq nuqta.

⚠ 'Zeebrugge' flamandcha 'dengiz Bryuggesi'
degani (Bryugge shahrining porti).

exercises.instructionEn: Speaking:  • What type of transport do you prefer and why?  • Do you have any ports or long tunnels in your country? Talk about them.
exercises.instructionUz: Gapirish:  • Qanday transport turini afzal ko'rasiz va nega?  • Sizning mamlakatingizda port yoki uzun tunnellar bormi? Ular haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'SPEAKING' — GAPIRISh MAShQI.

  Yozma javob talab qilinmaydi — ovoz
  chiqarib gapiriladi.


BIRINChI SAVOL:
  'What type of transport do you prefer
   and why?'

  ⚠ 'to prefer' = afzal ko'rmoq
  ⚠ 'prefer' da 'r' IKKILANADI:
     preferRED, preferRING
     (urg'u oxirgi bo'g'inda)

  JAVOB QOLIPI:
     'I prefer travelling by [transport]
      because it is [sabab].'

  NAMUNA:
     'I prefer travelling by train because
      it is comfortable and you can see
      the countryside. I don't like flying
      because it is expensive.'

  ⚠ 'prefer' dan keyin IKKI ShAKL mumkin:
     'I prefer TRAVELLING by train.'
     'I prefer TO TRAVEL by train.'


IKKINChI SAVOL:
  'Do you have any ports or long tunnels
   in your country? Talk about them.'

  ⚠ O'ZBEKISTON HAQIDA JAVOB:

  PORT:
     ⚠ O'zbekiston — DENGIZGA ChIQIShI YO'Q
     mamlakat ('a landlocked country').
     Shuning uchun dengiz porti YO'Q.

     JAVOB QOLIPI:
     'Uzbekistan is a landlocked country,
      so we don't have any sea ports.
      We have airports instead - the
      biggest one is in Tashkent.'

  TUNNEL:
     ⚠ O'zbekistonda tog' yo'llarida
     tunnellar bor (masalan, Qamchiq
     dovonidagi tunnel).

     JAVOB QOLIPI:
     'We have mountain tunnels in
      Uzbekistan. There is a long railway
      tunnel at the Kamchik Pass. It
      connects the Fergana Valley with
      the rest of the country.'

  ⚠ 'landlocked' = quruqlik bilan o'ralgan,
  dengizga chiqishi yo'q.


⚠ MUHOKAMA UChUN FOYDALI IBORALAR:

  'I prefer ... because ...'
  'In my opinion, ...'   = menimcha
  'I think ...'          = o'ylaymanki
  'For example, ...'     = masalan
  'On the other hand, ...' = boshqa tomondan


⚠ TRANSPORT TURLARI:

     by train  = poyezdda
     by plane  = samolyotda
     by car    = mashinada
     by bus    = avtobusda
     by boat   = kema bilan
     by bike   = velosipedda
     on foot   = piyoda  ⚠ ('by' EMAS!)

points.en: What type of transport do you prefer and why?
points.uz: Qanday transport turini afzal ko'rasiz va nega?
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to prefer' = afzal ko'rmoq.
⚠ 'r' IKKILANADI: preferRED, preferRING.

⚠ Ikki shakl ham to'g'ri:
  'I prefer TRAVELLING by train.'
  'I prefer TO TRAVEL by train.'

points.en: I prefer travelling by train because it is cheaper and more comfortable than flying.
points.uz: Men poyezdda sayohat qilishni afzal ko'raman, chunki u samolyotdan arzonroq va qulayroq.
points.noteUz:
⚠ NAMUNA JAVOB.

⚠ 'because' bilan SABAB berish shart —
savolda 'and why?' deb so'ralgan.

⚠ 'cheapER', 'MORE comfortable' — qiyosiy
darajaning ikki yo'li.

points.en: Do you have any ports or long tunnels in your country?
points.uz: Sizning mamlakatingizda port yoki uzun tunnellar bormi?
points.noteUz:
⚠ SAVOLDA 'ANY' — inkor va so'roq gaplarda
('some' — tasdiq gaplarda).

'Do you have ANY ports?'  ✓
'We have SOME tunnels.'   ✓

points.en: Uzbekistan is a landlocked country, so we don't have any sea ports.
points.uz: O'zbekiston — dengizga chiqishi yo'q mamlakat, shuning uchun bizda dengiz portlari yo'q.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'landlocked' = quruqlik bilan o'ralgan
('land' + 'locked' — 'quruqlikka qulflangan').

⚠ O'zbekiston — dunyodagi kam sonli IKKI
KARRA landlocked mamlakatlardan biri
(qo'shnilarining ham dengizga chiqishi yo'q).

⚠ 'so' = shuning uchun (natija).

points.en: There is a long railway tunnel at the Kamchik Pass.
points.uz: Qamchiq dovonida uzun temir yo'l tunneli bor.

patterns.exampleEn: The Channel Tunnel is 50 km long and 40 metres below the seabed.
patterns.exampleUz: Tunnel 50 km uzunlikda va dengiz tubidan 40 metr pastda.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Raqam OLDIN, sifat KEYIN:
'50 km long' ✓ / 'long 50 km' ✗

patterns.exampleEn: It's more expensive than a ferry, but quicker.

patterns.formula: Thanks to [narsa], it is now possible to [fe'l].
patterns.exampleEn: Thanks to the Channel Tunnel, it is now possible to spend the day in Paris.
patterns.exampleUz: Tunnel tufayli endi kunni Parijda o'tkazish mumkin.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'thanks to' — YAXSHI natija uchun.
⚠ 'it is possible TO' + fe'l.

patterns.exampleEn: Since it opened in 1994, 57 million people have travelled through the tunnel.
patterns.exampleUz: 1994-yilda ochilganidan beri 57 million odam tunneldan o'tgan.

patterns.exampleEn: I prefer travelling by train because it is cheaper.
patterns.exampleUz: Men poyezdda sayohat qilishni afzal ko'raman, chunki u arzonroq.
patterns.explanationUz:
Speaking uchun javob qolipi.
⚠ 'prefer to travel' ham to'g'ri.
